title: De-identify a text
summary: Replace identifiers with [KIND_N] placeholders and return the map.

inputs.text: Alice Smith (alice@example.org) approved [DRAFT] on 3 March in Perth.

sections.use: Replace names, organisations, places, dates, contact details and ID numbers with [KIND_N] placeholders before text is sent elsewhere, keeping the map so the originals can be restored. Use it in the shipped workflow: check_identifier_map, a Release Gate, the remote block, then restore_identifiers.
sections.exclusions: In agentic Chat it is a local redaction aid only; for Gate approval use a saved workflow.
sections.effects: Every port is Local only: the text and the map stay on this machine and its model must be local (or trusted local). It returns a value for review.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 12,288 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Text up to 40,000 characters; up to 500 map entries. The model can miss identifiers or choose wrong ones; a Release Gate review is still required.
sections.missing_data: A text with no identifiers is returned unchanged with an empty map. Bracket tokens already in the text, such as [DRAFT], are left as they are.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

outputs.identifier_map: The map: placeholder, original and kind.
